record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace uniform masked-target loss averaging with recency-weighted averaging: weight each masked target by 1 + 0.5*(its zero-based ordinal among real sequence positions)/max(real sequence length-1,1), then divide summed weighted cross-entropy by summed weights. Retain temperature 0.8 and zero smoothing. This emphasizes recent prediction contexts while retaining all masked supervision. Preserve sampling, embeddings, topology, scoring, optimizer and training settings; retain one model per category.
